headline: Mobile parity is now attested, and the Worker deploy token-scope requirement is locally gated instead of buried in CI logs.

items.title: CANON-041 Mobile Parity Attestation
items.insight: The website already had strong mobile contracts, but portfolio scanners could not see that proof. The repo now carries a durable mobile-parity attestation and status fields that release gates can trust.

items.title: Worker Deploy Token-Scope Contract
items.insight: The Worker deploy red is no longer a vague Cloudflare failure. The build now checks that any R2-bound Worker deploy token docs name R2 Bucket Read/Edit before the workflow reaches production CI.

followUps: Repair or replace CF_WORKER_API_TOKEN with R2 Bucket Read/Edit for vaultspark-rum, then rerun Worker deploy.
Use Ark/pattern-share for sibling mobile-parity attestations instead of editing their trees.
blockers: Actual Cloudflare Worker deploy remains gated on provider token scope, not code.

honestyLedger.title: No deploy-green claim
honestyLedger.why: The session clarified and gated the required token scope but did not pretend the Cloudflare token was repaired.

honestyLedger.title: No sibling repo edits
honestyLedger.why: Portfolio mobile-parity gaps remain visible, but this repo only attested itself.
